jobs.title: Service Manager - Dallas, TX
jobs.description_text: Lucid is excited to announce the grand opening of our brand-new Service Center in Dallas, Texas. This new facility represents our continued investment in delivering an exceptional ownership experience and supporting the growing Lucid community throughout the region. We are building a talented team of service professionals who are passionate about innovation, customer excellence, and the future of sustainable transportation. Join us at an exciting time as we establish this state-of-the-art location and help shape the next chapter of Lucid's service operations from day one. jobs.title: Sr. 3D Generalist, UX
jobs.description_text: The Role We are looking for a Senior 3D Technical Artist & Motion Designer to join the Lucid UX/UI team and help define the next generation of digital vehicle experiences. This role sits at the intersection of 3D design, motion, real-time rendering, and product development. You will create high-quality vehicle visualizations, real-time 3D assets, animations, and motion experiences for customer-facing applications while ensuring that content performs efficiently within demanding embedded compute environments. You will work closely with UX/UI Designers, Vehicle Designers, Engineering, Product, Marketing, and other cross-functional partners to establish both the visual quality and the production processes required to bring sophisticated 3D experiences into production. The ideal candidate combines a strong visual eye with deep technical fluency. You should be equally comfortable refining lighting and materials in a 3D scene, rigging and animating a vehicle, optimizing an asset for a constrained GPU target, collaborating with engineers on implementation, and using emerging AI tools to accelerate and improve the creative workflow. jobs.description_text: What You’ll Learn Project Overview: In memory-centric AI accelerators, many memory devices each process data in place and only exchange small partial results, which are then merged. As LLM attention evolves from grouped-query attention (GQA) to multi-head latent attention (MLA) and sparse top-k attention, the work done locally on each device shrinks while cross-device merge and reduction increasingly dominate decode latency. Using the team’s in-house performance model and simulator, you will explore the design space of merge/reduction architectures — where reduction happens, how devices are connected, and at what precision partial results are exchanged — and propose an architecture that performs well across modern attention workloads. The team builds the systems that support schema transfer, bulk data loading, real-time Change Data Capture (CDC), large-table migrations, and a native experience in SingleStore Helios. jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE TEAM Strategic Defense builds the command and control and fire control software for integrated air and missile defense. We work the hard end of the problem: ballistic missiles, hypersonic glide vehicles, cruise missiles, and saturation raids that arrive faster than any human-paced decision cycle can absorb. The US air and missile defense enterprise was assembled over four decades, one program at a time. Army air defense runs on one battle manager, short range air defense on another, the ballistic missile defense system on a third, and the fleet on a fourth. Each of them was engineered well for the threat it was scoped against. None of them was designed to be extended by anyone other than the prime that built it, which is why adding a sensor or an effector to an existing architecture is still a multi-year integration program rather than a software release. That is the opening we are working. A software-defined fire control layer, built on Lattice, with interfaces open enough that a new sensor, a new interceptor, or a new effects chain can be brought in at the pace software moves rather than the pace a hardware program moves. The technical case is strong and the early programs are real. What we need now is someone who can turn that into share inside programs of record.
